Classic look, with a little extra fluff ✨

My client wanted something soft and natural — nothing too thick or heavy.

We went with 0.03 volume lashes, applying 3–5 lightweight extensions per natural lash. The fans were kept more closed to create that classic-style finish, while still adding a little softness and fluff. 🤍

The result? A beautifully defined lash line that feels super lightweight and comfortable, without looking too full or overpowering.

Perfect for anyone who loves the classic look but wants just that little bit extra ✨

✨ LASH MODELS WANTED ✨

I'm looking for a small number of models to create some very special signature lash sets for my 2027 competition portfolio. 🏆

These aren't my usual appointments — I'll be designing each set specifically around the model's individual eye shape, features and natural lashes, with a huge focus on detail, styling and creating something unique.

I'm looking for models who:

🤍 Have healthy natural lashes
🤍 Are happy to lie still for a longer appointment while I perfect the set
🤍 Are comfortable having clear before & after photographs taken
🤍 Are happy for the images to be used as part of my competition/award portfolio and social media
🤍 Can be flexible with appointment times
🤍 Are reliable — please only apply if you can definitely attend

I'm particularly interested in working with a variety of eye shapes and features, so please don't worry if you think your eyes aren't "perfect" for lashes — that may be exactly what I'm looking for!

The sets will be chosen based on what I feel will best complement each model and showcase my styling.

📩 To apply:
Please send me a clear, makeup-free photo of your eyes open and closed, taken in natural daylight, along with your current lash situation (bare lashes / extensions / lash lift).

Please don't be offended if you're not selected — I'm looking for very specific characteristics for each set I'm planning. 🤍

A recommendation might seem like such a small thing… but sometimes it means absolutely everything. ❤️

Three years ago, someone asked for recommendations for the best place to get their eyelashes done. Out of all the options, they chose to trust me.

Fast forward to today, and that one recommendation has turned into three years of loyalty, laughs, beautiful lashes and the loveliest client relationship. 🥹

It’s easy to forget the power of telling someone, “You should go to her.” Those few words can help a small business grow, introduce us to incredible people, and create connections that last for years.

I’ll never stop being grateful for every person who recommends me, tags me, shares my work or sends a friend my way. Your support means more than you’ll ever know. 🤍

Here’s to the clients who become so much more than clients. 🫶
